questions.q: Report: 'Do you like cricket?' he asked me.
questions.a: 'He asked me if/whether I liked cricket.' A wrong answer 'he asked did I like' keeps question-order inside the report — the core error this node targets.

questions.q: Report: 'Where have you been?' mother asked.
questions.a: 'Mother asked where I had been.' wh-word kept, order restored, have→had. A wrong answer 'that where I had been' glues 'that' onto a wh-question — illegal.

questions.q: Report: 'Don't touch the fence,' the guard said to us.
questions.a: 'The guard told/ordered us not to touch the fence.' A wrong answer 'told to not touch' misses the object; 'not to touch' is the preferred negative placement.

questions.q: Reported questions and commands change shape, not just tense: questions lose their ______ and question mark ('Where do you live?' → 'He asked where I lived'); commands become 'told + object + to-infinitive' ('Sit down' → 'He told me to sit down').

questions.a: The student reports yes/no questions with if/whether, wh-questions with the wh-word kept, and commands with the told+object+to-infinitive frame — including negatives ('not to').
